summary: The agent failed because it rounded output to 2 decimals (the #1 verifier failure pattern) and lacked a reusable workflow for JSON-based lab panel harmonization. The existing clinical-lab-harmonization skill covers CSV input and conversion factors, but this task required JSON parsing with nested structure, status filtering (final vs draft), and nested key flattening. This new skill captures the JSON-specific workflow while referencing existing conversion logic.
